Class ExtraUpperCardPicking

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.state.ExtraUpperCardPicking
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ExtraUpperCardPicking extends GameState
Optional post-picking phase where players with the matching building may take extra cards from the upper row before the round ends.

    • skipExtraUpperCardPick

      public void skipExtraUpperCardPick(Player p) throws InvalidActionException
      Declines the optional extra upper-row pick: validates that it is the given player's turn and then advances straight to RoundEnding without drawing any card. The extra pick is optional by the rules (the building reads "you may take 1 card"), so a player who does not want it must be able to skip.
      Overrides:
      skipExtraUpperCardPick in class GameState
      Parameters:
      p - the player declining the extra pick
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if it is not p's turn
